title: Seal
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water swoosh -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='38' ry='9' fill='#1b3a6b'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#8fb8d8'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='20' ry='11' fill='#c8e2f2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#9ec7e4'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#d9eef9'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#112244'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#112244'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#3a5a80'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 46 Q50 50 54 46' stroke='#6b8fb3' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='0.9' fill='#6b8fb3'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='47' r='0.9' fill='#6b8fb3'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='0.9' fill='#6b8fb3'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='47' r='0.9' fill='#6b8fb3'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='62' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#7aa6c8' transform='rotate(15 20 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='62' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#7aa6c8' transform='rotate(-15 80 62)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 70 Q8 62 4 74 Q12 74 18 76' fill='#7aa6c8'/>
  <path d='M78 70 Q92 62 96 74 Q88 74 82 76' fill='#7aa6c8'/>
  <!-- small splash -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='82' r='2.5' fill='#4a7fa8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='82' r='2.5' fill='#4a7fa8'/>
</svg>
